title: Mithras liturgy ascent through seven heavens

tellings.quote: In the Mithras liturgy found in Greek magical Papyri, an initiate employs breathing techniques, visualizations, chants, and ceremonial rituals to ascend through the seven heavens.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the Mithras Liturgy, an ancient text found in a collection of Greek magic spells written on papyrus. He says that in it, a person being initiated uses breathing, visualisation, chanting and ritual to rise up through seven heavens. He brings it up as an ancient example of people trying to reach other levels of reality.
